name: cavity [RELEASE]
desc:
a horror game like doors in an underwater cave where you try to escape while buying upgrades and playing with your friends

❗ the game contains loud sounds, screamers, and maybe flashing lights ❗

features:
- multiplayer support up to 8 players
- a lot of rooms to make the gameplay more unique
- items, corals, collectable thingies
- gameplay is forcing u to help ur teammates
- cool animations and cutscenes

- use code "1MVisitsAND10KLikes" for 250 money

pc controls:
shift - sprint
backspace while holding an item - drop
H - unlock the mouse
F - enable/disable flashlight
